search_method: Parallel primary-source searches on semantic revision, local-state sufficiency and executable world models; hf 1.29.0 papers search used for discovery; arXiv full methods, author sources and official proceedings used for claims. Purposeful mechanism review, not an exhaustive systematic review.

sources.title: WorldCoder, a Model-Based LLM Agent: Building World Models by Writing Code and Interacting with the Environment
sources.scope_read: Sections 2.1–2.5, 3, 5, Appendix F; metadata revision history.
sources.paper_finding: Synthesizes Python transition/reward models from environment transitions, refines using inconsistencies, and combines data consistency with optimistic goal reachability. Assumes deterministic dynamics and symbolic states; evaluates Sokoban, MiniGrid and a fluent-state conversion of AlfWorld.
sources.hswm_inference: Use failed transitions plus retention examples to propose relation revisions. A code executor can be a diagnostic comparator; it cannot silently replace the HSWM LLM-function core. Goal optimism must not turn wished-for outcomes into observed evidence.

sources.title: PoE-World: Compositional World Modeling with Products of Programmatic Experts
sources.paper_finding: Synthesizes small programmatic experts, fits exponential weights by likelihood and prunes low-weight experts. Object features are conditionally independent given history, enabling feature-wise normalization. Experiments concern object-centric Pong and Montezuma's Revenge, not raw-pixel world modeling or solved general exploration.
sources.hswm_inference: Investigate modular exception revisions. Do not identify expert weights with Semantic Weight, or import feature independence into a required joint-output law without a coupling test.

sources.title: Modeling Open-World Cognition as On-Demand Synthesis of Probabilistic Models
sources.scope_read: Model Synthesis Architectures method, experiment framing, Experimental Limitations and Limitations in Model Synthesis.
sources.paper_finding: Uses LM-guided candidate parsing, background-variable/dependency construction and probabilistic-program inference. Tests fit to human judgments in sports vignettes. Reports prompt sensitivity, low candidate diversity and difficulty inventing temporal primitives until demonstrated; stronger reasoner baselines remain outstanding.
sources.hswm_inference: Allow task-conditioned missing-variable and relation proposals while measuring omission. Human-judgment agreement does not establish world truth, state sufficiency or independent outcome learning.

sources.title: Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse
sources.scope_read: Proceedings abstract and PDF problem framing/holdout reuse discussion. No theorem or differential-privacy algorithm is imported.
sources.paper_finding: Adaptive reuse can overfit a holdout; the paper studies controlled reuse and generalization guarantees.
sources.hswm_inference: Separate candidate-generation data, reusable selection validation and a sealed final test. Feedback from the final test retires that test for further confirmatory use. The proposed HSWM protocol does not implement the paper's reusable-holdout guarantee.

artifact_policy: No third-party package, model, repository checkout or executable was installed. URLs and versions identify reviewed sources; URL hashes, if projected, are location digests rather than downloaded-content hashes. Publication licenses are not inferred to authorize code reuse. Implementation adoption requires separate exact source/license/integrity pins.
